import json, os, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); import gen

def make(nslots, nwindows, nflows, seed=7):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    case = {"model": rng.choice(['cnn','rnn']),
            "class_values":[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],
            "stats":[rng.randint(1,1000)]*3,
            "bucket":[min(64, nslots), min(64, nslots)],
            "slots":[[t*10, rng.randint(0,4), 0 if i==0 else rng.randint(0,3)] for i,t in enumerate(range(nslots))],
            "flows":[[rng.randint(1,4), rng.randint(4,8), -1, rng.randint(0,6)] for _ in range(nflows)],
            "groups":[],
            "windows":[[rng.randrange(nflows), rng.randint(0,50), rng.randint(50,nslots*10), rng.randint(1,65535),
                        rng.randint(1,320), rng.randint(0,65535), rng.randint(1,1000),
                        [[rng.randint(0,1500), rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]] for _ in range(nwindows)]}
    return {"version":3,"cases":[case]}

for (ns, nw, nf) in [(10,30,3),(30,100,5),(60,200,8),(100,300,10)]:
    req = make(ns,nw,nf)
    env = dict(os.environ); env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']='/workspace/native'
    t=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=json.dumps(req).encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env, timeout=300)
    el=time.time()-t
    print('slots=%d windows=%d flows=%d -> %.2fs exit=%d out=%d bytes' % (ns,nw,nf,el,p.returncode,len(p.stdout)))
    if p.returncode: print(p.stderr.decode()[:500])
PYEOF
